rationale: The agent verified the user via email and checked the user’s orders. However, it initiated cancellations for two pending orders (#W4836353 and #W7342738) without first stating the exact changes and obtaining explicit confirmation, violating the requirement to confirm before any order-changing write. Later, the agent did properly seek confirmation before initiating returns for the delivered orders. Additionally, it asserted that orders #W2586676 and #W5400801 were already cancelled and refunded without clearly supported evidence in the visible tool outputs (they were truncated), which risks unsupported statements. Because of the unconfirmed cancellations, the conversation fails the policy’s confirmation requirement despite otherwise acting on the correct account and using appropriate tools.
